original_ai_output.title_zh: 活动人士塞米·凯巴在南非法庭受挫后面临被引渡至贝宁
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 贝宁活动人士凯米·塞巴（Kemi Seba）在南非法院驳回其外交豁免主张后，面临被引渡至贝宁的前景。他此前因签证逾期于4月被捕，并声称自己当时是尼日尔政府的代表。法院裁定没有证据表明他被认证为驻南非外交官。贝宁于12月12日对其发出国际逮捕令，理由是他支持一场被挫败的政变，政变中哗变士兵曾在电视上声称推翻总统帕特里斯·塔隆。

key_facts.fact: 南非法院驳回凯米·塞巴的外交豁免主张，使其更接近被引渡至贝宁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Firebrand activist Kemi Seba's prospect of facing a Beninese judge moved remarkably closer after a South African court rejected his claim of diplomatic immunity.

key_facts.fact: 塞巴声称被捕时是尼日尔政府代表，但法院裁定无证据表明其被认证为驻南非外交官
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Through his lawyers, Seba had told court that he was a representative of the government of Niger at the time of his arrest for overstaying his visa in April. But the court ruled that there was no evidence that the activist had been accredited as a diplomat to South Africa.

key_facts.fact: 贝宁于12月12日对其发出国际逮捕令，理由是他支持一场被挫败的政变
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Benin issued an international warrant for the influencer's arrest on December 12 after he supported a foiled coup in which mutinous soldiers claimed on television to have overthrown President Patrice Talon

uncertainties: 政变中哗变士兵声称推翻总统塔隆的说法尚未证实
目前仅一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
